summary: Renders a linked list of geometry mesh blocks onto one or more locked texture surfaces. Builds an Euler rotation matrix from an object transform (selecting pitch-only or full 3-axis based on flag bits in this+0x20), clears per-surface vertex/index allocation counters, walks each mesh block's child nodes copying transform/color state, packs per-vertex color words, then unlocks each surface and submits it with its accumulated vertex and index counts.

operations.description: If signed byte flag at this+0x20 is negative, the render-to-texture pass is disabled (surface invalidated/locked): skip geometry generation.

In the disabled branch, when *(this+0x30) (texture block pointer) is non-null, unlock/release the surface via TextureSurfaceUnlockRelease(this, 0) and submit sub_55CF50(a2, *(this+0x50) descriptor array, stride_x = *(this+0x30)**(this+0x24), stride_y = *(this+0x30)**(this+0x28)).
Active geometry path is taken when this+0x20 >= 0 and *(this+0x30) is non-null.
Initialize the 3x3 rotation matrix scratch v43 with F_10FloatStructInitializer.
If dword at this+0x20 has bit 0x20 set, use pitch-only rotation: F_3FieldGetter(a3, &v32, &v27, &v31), negate v27, then EulerAngleToRotationMatrix(v43, 0.0, -v27, 0.0).
Else if dword at this+0x20 has bit 0x10 set, use full 3-axis rotation: F_3FieldGetter(a3, &v32, &v27, &v31), negate all three components, then EulerAngleToRotationMatrix(v43, -v32, -v27, -v31).
For each of the *(this+0x4C) surfaces: reset the vertex count at *(this+0x44)+4*i and index count at *(this+0x48)+4*i to 0, then call TextureAllocationWithFormatSizeFlags(this, i).
Set v33/v6 to the first mesh block *(this+0x38), traverse with LinkedListTraversal(a2, 0), and read a per-vertex scalar factor via FieldGetterByIndex(2, &v36).
Walk the mesh block linked list: v6 follows the next pointer *(v6+0x7C); the walk ends when the next pointer is null.
If this[32] AND 0x30 is non-zero, copy the 48-byte v44 block into v6+0x38 (v6+14 floats), then copy three fields out of and back into v6+0x10 via ThreeFieldAccessor and MultiFieldSetter.
If *(v6+0x0) has bit 0x4000 set, read three fields from v6+0x10 via TripleFieldGetter_b1d0 and pass them to sub_53B330(v6+0x10, ...).
Apply conditional scaling to v6+0x10 with ConditionalScaleApply(v6+4).

For each surface descriptor at *(this+0x50) (64-byte stride), iterate its vertex stream: for each vertex call the D3D wrapper function pointer at (*(dword_8B8F24)+4), storing packed color at v13+32 and lighting/packed words at v13+36 and v13+24 (v13-40); the loop bound is the surface vertex count at descriptor+8.

Build the packed per-vertex color word v17 from v34 (color word at *(v6+0xC)) and v15 (vertex color byte): v37 = (double)HIBYTE(v34) * v36, truncate to __int16 v41, and combine ((v41<<8) + byte products) into a 32-bit color.
After each surface's vertex loop, accumulate its vertex count (descriptor+8) into *(this+0x44)+4*i and its index count (descriptor+16) into *(this+0x48)+4*i.
Advance to the next mesh block: v33 = *(v6+0x7C); break out of the list walk when it is null.

For each of the *(this+0x4C) surfaces: unlock/release with TextureSurfaceUnlockRelease(this, i), then submit sub_55CF50(a2, descriptor = *(this+0x50)+64*i, accumulated vertex count at *(this+0x44)+4*i, accumulated index count at *(this+0x48)+4*i).

unresolved: dword_8B78A0 is listed as read evidence but does not appear in the raw decompiled text; its role is unknown.
The exact packing formula for the per-vertex color word and the semantic meaning of v36 are only partially recovered.
The source and role of the 48-byte v44 block copied into each mesh node is not established from this function alone.
